definitions.gloss: excellent, very good, couldn't be better
definitions.explanation: Describes a result or outcome that meets or exceeds expectations. Often used when evaluating performance, results, or progress, with a tone of satisfaction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう}だ。
examples.english: We're off to an excellent start.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう}だった。

⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き→売れ行き：14897_ureyuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう}で、⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Sales of the new product have been excellent, exceeding expectations.

notes:
{上々|じょうじょう} is a reduplication of ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upper, good) and conveys strong satisfaction with an outcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう} (the result is excellent)
- ⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう} (off to an excellent start)
- ⟦{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き→売れ行き：14897_ureyuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう} (sales are going very well)
- ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう} (grades/results are very good)
- {上々|じょうじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧ (an excellent finish)

USAGE:
- Most commonly used as a predicate: 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上々|じょうじょう}だ
- Implies the result exceeded what was merely acceptable
- Has a somewhat mature or evaluative tone; less casual than ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ or ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧
